data.one_liner: A Flutter InteractiveViewer replacement with scrollbars and double-tap zoom.
data.what_it_does: InteractiveViewer2 provides a drop-in replacement for Flutter's default InteractiveViewer. It supports mouse wheel zoom, scrollbars, double-tap zoom, and improved handling for widgets larger than the viewport.
use_when: You need scrollbars inside an interactive or zoomable viewport
You want desktop mouse wheel zoom support out of the box
You need better handling for widgets that exceed viewport size
avoid_when: You require the exact default behavior of Flutter's built-in InteractiveViewer with constrained property enabled by default
strengths: Adds scrollbar support to zoomable content
Supports mouse wheel and double-tap zoom gestures
Allows creating custom interactive widgets via provided base classes
weaknesses: Constrained property behaves differently from the standard InteractiveViewer by default
